segments.text: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: ¶ The sower soweth the word.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
¶ And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
¶ And he said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
¶ And he said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Let us pass over unto the other side.
And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him,

segments.speaker: The disciples
segments.text: and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Peace, be still.
And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another,

segments.speaker: Disciples
segments.text: What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
